answer: Each answer must carry a receipt for one ledger batch its identity verified, chosen by the epoch seed, stamped with the opal hash and filed in the ivory log, so none is reused. One batch takes two minutes per core; the ocean of pending transactions supplies fresh batches per epoch. No valid receipt means rejection; a receipt used twice triggers enforcement: both 25,000 POA bonds seized, half burned, half to the reporter. 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA and 2,000 core-minutes; one honest agent pays 25,000 POA once, two minutes. Limitation: this taxes scale, not wealth buying a compute farm.
